turns.prompt: Fit the nonlinear model y = b1 * exp[b2/(x+b3)] to the data in mgh10.csv (columns x, y) by least squares, starting from b1 = 2, b2 = 400000, b3 = 25000. Report every parameter (b1, b2, b3) to at least 6 significant digits and the residual sum of squares as rss.

provenance: NIST StRD MGH10 (public domain), data copied verbatim
